newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee gains on dollar sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee gains on dollar sell-off.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee rose in early Friday trade on selling pressure on the dollar, dealers said.
At 0445 GMT the rupee was at 57.68 to the dollar after opening at its previous closing level of 57.75, they said.
"There is more selling pressure on the dollar and no buying at all, despite the Central Bank's action," said a Commercial Bank dealer.
The Central Bank pushed up the dollar by 5.5 local cents, fixing buying and selling levels at 57.1888 and 58.3442.
Dollar sell-offs were prompted by a state bank with a big inward remittance, said an American Express Bank dealer.
Overnight call money rates were at 10.5 percent after opening at 12, dealers said.
